formation_structure.artillery_geometry: Steward, second-deployment Midnight and temporary Lava have return-flight opportunities. Actual target selection and effective damage must be observed.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, natural recovery and executed vanguard grants only; no retreat refunds credited.
economy.boundary: Redeployment price rules were not supplied and are not invented. Missing grants indicate failed survival or skill execution; the ledger does not repair that failure.
economy.hibiscus_return_affordability_requiremen: At frame 6750, conditional resources total 295 DP before spending; Midnight and Hibiscus redeployment debits together must not exceed 98 DP.
economy.midnight_redeploy_affordability_requirem: The actual redeployment debit must be at most 28 DP for the complete frame-4650 sequence under this conservative ledger.

formation_structure.interceptions: Maintain upper central, lower central, upper outer and lower outer ownership. A functioning healer does not establish that interception or clearance is sufficient.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Ansel DOWN and Hibiscus UP cover each other, both central tiles and both western caster tiles. Ordinary ranges exclude the outer row-6 blocker; no passive healing of Beagle is assumed.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla attack across adjacent central rows. Lancet arrives at frame 420 before the retained early mortality observations.
formation_structure.slots: Peak occupancy is eight. Every same-tile or ninth-slot deployment follows its predecessor's retreat, including same-frame exchanges in listed order.

formation_transitions.transition: Beagle replaces lower Midnight; Midnight's 2100-frame cooldown begins.
Hibiscus replaces Lancet and completes reciprocal professional treatment.
Durin completes the two western clearance assignments.
Midnight replaces Plume after exactly 2100 frames; civilian separation must already hold.
Lava replaces Hibiscus; Ansel becomes the sole professional medic.
Lava withdraws at the committed burst endpoint; artillery survival here falsifies the planned clearance handoff.
Ansel's existing enhancement bridges late treatment demand.
Hibiscus returns after the full 2100-frame cooldown. The former frame-6600 deployment is removed.
Hibiscus receives her first post-return enhancement after 30 inactive seconds.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity 1–3 and qualification.normal_mode true. Every deployment uses an available legal tile and cardinal direction.
Never deploy on an active roadblock tile.

Midnight returns at 3750 after retreat at 1650; Hibiscus returns at 6750 after retreat at 4650. Both intervals equal 2100 frames. Retreat predecessors before listed same-frame replacements; occupancy never exceeds eight.
Observe Lancet healing Fang before the retained frame-687 danger boundary, and separately verify both central vanguards survive their opening engagements.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block neutral civilians. Maintain separation from officers and observe exactly two safe arrivals with zero protected deaths.
Spend only actual DP. Failed grants are survival or execution failures. No refunds, unsupported skill income or unverified redeployment-price formula may repair the ledger.
Ansel must sustain the actual injuries during frames 4650–6750, including the additional 150 frames. His treatment event alone does not establish sufficient throughput.
Confirm artillery death through observed effective damage, not range overlap. Its surviving fixed-point projectiles remain hazards after death.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and both expected protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Prove early Lancet treatment, central survival and establishment of all four interceptions.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A central death or leak breaks the opening and conditional income chain.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish professional treatment, replace lower Midnight and start both western roadblock clearance duties.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Healing events without adequate survival or queue clearance do not validate this phase.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Verify civilian release and separation; complete ground handoffs and charge second Midnight.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: An unsafe upper handoff invalidates both protection and its proposed artillery contribution.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Clear artillery during the burst, preserve lanes under Ansel, then bridge the full 70-second Hibiscus absence.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Caster loss, treatment failure, artillery escape or a broken interception rejects the burst structure.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Restore reciprocal healing, clear late queues and verify both protected arrivals and complete hostile exhaustion.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Elapsed time cannot substitute for the complete acceptance predicate; extend observation beyond frame 12000 if necessary.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic grants are expected at frames 570, 1320, 2070, 2820, 3570 and 4320 while alive and deployed. Record actual grants.
Initial readiness follows 14 inactive seconds. Ten active seconds plus twenty recharge seconds separate activations.
Initial readiness follows 25 inactive seconds. Later cycles include 25 active and 35 recharge seconds. The frame-6720 activation lasts through frame 7470 and bridges Hibiscus's delayed return.
First deployment charges from frame 2400 to 3300. Redeployment at 6750 resets readiness; enhancement at 7650 requires thirty new inactive seconds. Remove the former frame-7500 activation.
Hold the ready skill for the final upper-outer engagement before withdrawal; no continued benefit after retreat.
Forty initial charging seconds; subsequent cycles include thirty active and forty recharge seconds.
Second deployment at 3750 starts from 30 SP; forty inactive seconds enable arts for frames 4950–6150. First-deployment SP is not transferred.
Deployment grants 30 SP; eleven inactive seconds permit the supported attack-speed skill. Credit individual modeled hits without splash multiplication.
Use supported attack-SP enhanced hits without assuming high-defense targeting or passive ATK bonuses.
Ordinary modeled attacks only; no unsupported self-healing, guardian healing, dodge or talent bonuses.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Preserve V3's reciprocal opening, immediate Lancet support, four interceptions, western roadblock clearance and temporary artillery burst as unverified tactical commitments. Repair the confirmed Hibiscus cooldown conflict with a fixed return at frame 6750 and first post-return skill at 7650. Ansel retains treatment responsibility through the extended absence. Opening survival, civilian separation, actual income and artillery clearance remain independent acceptance dependencies.

revised_stage_understanding.causal_boundary: V3 was statically blocked and never simulated. Its cooldown conflict is confirmed; its tactical outcome is unknown. Earlier opening deaths and insufficient caster survival remain conditional causal evidence.
revised_stage_understanding.current_model_rules: Actions use 30 FPS and [row,col]. Time-SP pauses during active skills. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians; roadblocks can detain them. Officers can attack civilians within 1.2.
revised_stage_understanding.gamedata_facts: Hibiscus requires 70 seconds to redeploy. Source routes, catalog stats and skill parameters constrain the plan.
unknown: Exact client timing and target-order ties.

revised_stage_understanding.validation_status: Unsimulated candidate. Read-only shell access failed before file inspection; no compiler result or new tactical success is claimed.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.changed_assumption: A return 65 seconds after retreat is illegal; the committed return now waits the full seventy seconds.
falsifiers: No early Lancet treatment of Fang or either opening vanguard dying.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: The confirmed static cooldown defect can be repaired while retaining V3's tactical structure if Ansel sustains the additional five-second medical gap and Hibiscus recharges from her corrected return.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.retained_but_unverified: Immediate Lancet support, four interceptions, western detention clearance and the temporary artillery burst remain candidates, not demonstrated V3 improvements.

revised_tactical_requirements.completion: Positive remaining life, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and exactly two safe protected arrivals.
revised_tactical_requirements.connected_changes: Extend Ansel's sole-medic responsibility by 150 frames and delay Hibiscus's post-return enhancement by 150 frames. Preserve the existing frame-6720 Ansel bridge.
revised_tactical_requirements.economy_check: Use the explicit conditional ledger and actual redeployment debits. Missing income is a broken survival or execution dependency.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening_check: Observe Lancet healing Fang before the retained early mortality boundary; independently verify both vanguard engagements and first grants.
revised_tactical_requirements.repair: Remove Hibiscus DEPLOY at 6600; commit DEPLOY at 6750 and ACTIVATE_SKILL at 7650.
revised_tactical_requirements.static_checks: All action frames are nondecreasing, deployments are direction-complete and on legal terrain, same-frame exchanges retreat first, peak occupancy is eight, and both repeated operators receive 2100 cooldown frames.

Hibiscus returns at frame 6750 and provides her first post-return enhancement at frame 7650.

revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the opening-support prediction before the retained frame-687 mortality boundary. Inspect actual injury, range and treatment events; do not credit later Ansel treatment or future vanguard income as evidence that the opening survived.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: A fixed Hibiscus return at frame 6750 removes the confirmed cooldown conflict, while Ansel's retained frame-6720 enhancement may sustain the extended treatment gap. This repair remains dependent on independently verified opening survival, interception, civilian separation and artillery clearance.
